author: Unreal Engine
description:
Your in-island transaction analytics in Creator Portal tell you more than how much you earned. Conversion rate, ARPDAU, ARPPU, purchases per buyer, and average transaction value all move together, and reading them together can help you diagnose whether an offer is underperforming or has room to grow.

In this livestream, we'll walk through each chart in Creator Portal: what the metric actually measures, how to segment and filter by island and offer, why spikes and dips happen, and what to change in your island in response to those data points. 

Tune in on September 8 at 2 PM ET for our Creating in Fortnite livestream with Carson Taylor, John Raff, and Jeremy Mingo from Epic Games.

Learn more about UEFN: https://www.fortnite.com/developer  

#Fortnite #UEFN #FortniteCreative #UnrealEditorForFortnite #gamedevelopment
title: Reading Your Data and Iterating in Fortnite | Creating in Fortnite

author: Unreal Engine
description:
In this video, we'll take a look at how we designed a Puzzle Adventure Game using Unreal Engine. This video acts as an overview of our process, and the various tools and features we've used to design the gameplay, keys and doors, HUD, enemies, and player sprinting abilities for this game project. 

The full tutorial and a download link to the project can be found here: https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/unreal-engine/design-a-puzzle-adventure-game-in-unreal-engine
title: How We Designed a Puzzle Adventure Game in Unreal Engine
